Class ServerApp

java.lang.Object
ipossa.ServerApp
public final class ServerApp extends Object
Entry point for the IPOS-SA prototype server.

This class boots the SQLite-backed data layer, starts the embedded HTTP server, and serves both the REST API and the static frontend used for the demo.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception
      Starts the IPOS-SA server.

      Arguments are interpreted as:

      1. port
      2. database path
      3. static frontend root
      Parameters:
      args - optional startup arguments for port, database path, and static root
      Throws:
      Exception - if the database or HTTP server cannot be started

    • startServer

      static HttpServer startServer(int port, Path dbPath, Path staticRoot) throws Exception
      Starts the embedded IPOS-SA HTTP server using the supplied runtime configuration.
      Parameters:
      port - the port to bind the server to
      dbPath - the SQLite database file to use
      staticRoot - the folder containing the static frontend assets
      Returns:
      the started HTTP server instance
      Throws:
      Exception - if the database or HTTP server cannot be initialized
